primary_outcome: Correct inspected report selection and bounded result: status, complete failed and unknown check sets, and numeric measurements. Model finalisation measures model-authored decisions; checked finalisation measures retained checker output and must not be described as model accuracy. Context is host-bound and explanation is optional.
failure_rule: Retain every assignment with no effect-based stopping. Retry only provider-marked retryable http_server, timeout or transport failures, at most twice per trial after 1 and 2 seconds; every attempt uses the existing model-call cap and keeps unknown charges reserved. Exhausted transient retries fail that trial; three consecutive transient-failed trials stop the affected model. Known-cost invalid, incomplete or ambiguous replies fail their trial without retry. Fatal account/configuration errors, unclassified failures, unverified returned model identity or usage, host failures, checker/reference disagreement and exhausted admission allowance stop the model immediately. Preserve failed and unattempted assignments separately; instrument or evidence-integrity defects suspend affected comparisons.
scope: One orders API, up to 40 purposively reviewed development cases and six pinned snapshots. Model finalisation assigns up to six prompt/tool arms; checked finalisation assigns only EAL/MCP and ordinary validator. Analyse each selected snapshot, transport and finalisation separately. A small calibration precedes an explicitly selected larger invocation; conclusions describe only that finite suite and invocation.
